title: Verona — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Verona.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Kitchen Heritage." Verona (by EuroChef USA) imports Italian-made ranges in the Verona and Verona Prestige lines. Available in multiple colors including Matte White, Matte Black, and Bordeaux. Classic Italian styling with European convection.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers wanting Italian ranges with color options at mid-range pricing.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Verona:

• Italian-made ranges with genuine European styling

• Color options including Matte White, Black, and Bordeaux

• European convection baking

• Competitive with Bertazzoni at slightly lower pricing

• Available through independent dealers
